questions.q: On Melbourne Cup day the Reserve Bank lifted the cash rate. What is the new rate?
questions.f: The 25-basis-point rise was the RBA's fifth hike of 2026 and took the rate to its highest level since late 2008.

questions.q: How did the RBA's nine-member Monetary Policy Board split on the November rate rise?
questions.f: Three board members preferred to leave the rate on hold.

questions.q: Which Caribbean nation hosted this week's Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting (CHOGM)?
questions.f: The summit was held in St John's, and Albanese's visit was the first by an Australian PM to the Caribbean since 2009.

questions.q: At CHOGM, King Charles said which historical injustice filled him with 'the most profound personal sorrow'?
questions.f: The King voiced sorrow but stopped short of a formal apology.

questions.q: Certified results of Israel's election left a hung Knesset. Who leads the bloc that finished second to Netanyahu's?
questions.f: Netanyahu's bloc won 53 seats and Eisenkot's 48, short of the 61 needed; Arab-led parties won a record 19.

questions.q: A Russian strike on 2 November hit an aid hub in a former school in Komyshuvakha. Which Ukrainian region is it in?
questions.f: Dozens of civilians were killed, and US–Russia–Ukraine talks were announced for Abu Dhabi on 10–11 November.

questions.q: In South Africa's local elections this week, veteran DA figure Helen Zille ran for mayor of which city?
questions.f: A record 29.2 million South Africans were registered to vote, and results are due on Sunday.

questions.q: Which Asian country's president sacked his chief of staff, a former police chief accused of wiretapping officials?
questions.f: President Prabowo Subianto dismissed Listyo Sigit Prabowo, who was then arrested.

questions.q: Which online platform joined the Digital Freedom Project in a High Court challenge to Australia's under-16 social media ban?
questions.f: The two-day hearing wrapped up, with judgment expected in the coming months.

questions.q: Which 188-year-old Australian department store chain went into administration this week?
questions.f: McGrathNicol were appointed administrators of the 38-store retailer.

questions.q: Which energy giant said it will cut at least 500 jobs, about 10% of its workforce?
questions.f: The company aims to save $550 million a year from 2028.

questions.q: Which big four bank's full-year profit fell 9.1% to $6.14 billion, sending its shares down about 7.5%?
questions.f: NAB held its final dividend at 85 cents.

questions.q: The CCC criticised a $116 million Queensland Police lease on a building officers never moved into. In which Brisbane suburb is it?
questions.f: The watchdog found no dishonesty, and the Police Commissioner accepted all nine recommendations.

questions.q: Brisbane City Council approved the plan for a $105 million upgrade of the Lindum level crossing. Which suburb is it in?
questions.f: Most of the funding comes from the federal government, and work should be finished by the end of 2028.

questions.q: A three-metre saltwater crocodile was spotted at a golf club near which city's planned 2032 Olympic rowing venue?
questions.f: The sighting was at North Rockhampton Golf Club, a few kilometres from the Fitzroy River course.

questions.q: Mater announced about 430 job cuts as it outsources which hospital service?
questions.f: The cuts affect its South Brisbane and Springfield hospitals.

questions.q: Which spacecraft, launched in 1977, is about to become the first human-made object one light-day from Earth?
questions.f: It is due to pass the milestone on 18 November, about 25.9 billion km from home.

questions.q: Which NASA Mars rover was recognised by Guinness World Records for the farthest drive on another world?
questions.f: It had driven 45.22 km by 11 October 2026.

questions.q: Samples from asteroid Ryugu were found to hold all five DNA and RNA bases. Which mission brought them back?
questions.f: The Japanese probe returned the samples, and the findings appeared in Nature Astronomy.

questions.q: SLAC researchers reported conclusive proof of 'altermagnetism' in manganese telluride. It is described as a third type of what?
questions.f: Altermagnets combine features of ferromagnets and antiferromagnets; the term was coined in 2022.

questions.q: NASA says which space telescope could fall back into the atmosphere in 2033–34 unless it gets a boost by 2032?
questions.f: NASA has asked companies for servicing ideas, with responses due on 30 November.

questions.q: A major Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo virus has passed 10,000 confirmed cases. Which country is at its centre?
questions.f: The ECDC reports cases in eight Congolese provinces, plus a few in Kenya and Nigeria.

questions.q: What was Australia's annual headline CPI inflation rate for September?
questions.f: Trimmed mean inflation for the September quarter was 3.7%.

questions.q: OpenAI said ChatGPT now has roughly how many weekly users?
questions.f: It also reported 250 million weekly users of voice input.

questions.q: Canva announced 1,271 job cuts. Roughly what share of its staff is that?
questions.f: The Sydney-founded design company announced the cuts this week.

questions.q: By how much did national home values fall in October, according to Cotality?
questions.f: Values are now 6.7% below their March peak.

questions.q: Banks passing on the rate rise will push the average owner-occupier variable rate to about what, by Canstar's estimate?
questions.f: The big four lift variable rates by 0.25 points from 13 November.

questions.q: Which party projected to win control of the US House of Representatives in the midterms?
questions.f: Hakeem Jeffries is in line to become the first Black Speaker of the House.

questions.q: Abdul El-Sayed won a US Senate seat to become the first Muslim senator. Which state elected him?
questions.f: He defeated Republican Mike Rogers.

questions.q: Nationals leader Matt Canavan will seek preselection for which Queensland House seat?
questions.f: He would have to leave the Senate if preselected for the seat, which retiring MP Michelle Landry holds.

questions.q: Victorians vote on 28 November. Who is the Labor premier leading the party into the election?
questions.f: Carroll took over from Jacinta Allan about three months ago; the Opposition Leader is Jess Wilson.

questions.q: What is Collins Dictionary's 2026 Word of the Year, meaning to outshine or upstage someone?
questions.f: Collins said use of the word rose 210% over the year.

questions.q: 'Mogging' comes from the acronym AMOG. What does the A stand for?
questions.f: AMOG stands for 'Alpha Male of the Group'.

questions.q: On Collins' shortlist, what does 'carspreading' describe?
questions.a: Cars getting longer, wider and heavier
questions.f: The term joined 'ghost jobs' and 'bixie' on the 2026 shortlist.

questions.q: The shortlisted hairstyle word 'bixie' blends which two cuts?
questions.f: It is a classic portmanteau, like 'brunch' or 'smog'.

questions.q: Betelgeuse's newly supported companion star is called Siwarha, meaning 'her bracelet'. From which language does the name come?
questions.f: Fittingly, the name 'Betelgeuse' itself also has Arabic roots.

questions.q: The cash rate rose 0.25 percentage points. How many extra dollars a year in interest is that on a $600,000 loan?
questions.f: 0.25% of $600,000 is $1,500, or about $125 a month.

questions.q: Voyager 1 launched in 1977 and reaches one light-day from Earth in 2026. How many years apart are those dates?
Simon Harmer took 10 for 120 in the Newlands Test, including 6 for 16 in the second innings. How many runs did he concede in the first innings?
A lease costs $500,000 a month for 15 years. What is the total, in millions of dollars?
questions.f: $0.5m × 12 = $6m a year, × 15 = $90m. The real lease was valued at about $116 million.

questions.q: Which horse won the 2026 Melbourne Cup?
questions.f: Point of Law won by 3.75 lengths for jockey Ethan Brown, who was riding in his first Cup.

questions.q: Which trainer made Melbourne Cup history by training the first three horses home?
questions.f: It was his second Cup, after Gold Trip in 2022, and the first top-three clean sweep by a single trainer in 166 runnings.

questions.q: Kimi Antonelli clinched the F1 world title to become the youngest champion ever. At which Grand Prix?
questions.f: Max Verstappen won the race, and third place was enough for the Mercedes driver.

questions.q: Which Australian qualifier knocked seven-time champion Novak Djokovic out of the Paris Masters?
questions.f: Hijikata went on to reach his first Masters 1000 quarter-final.

questions.q: Which band finally earned its first US Billboard 200 No. 1, with a 20th-anniversary edition of 'The Black Parade'?
questions.f: No album has waited longer to reach No. 1; in 2006 it peaked at No. 2.

questions.q: Which Sydney punk band scored its first ARIA No. 1 album with 'GODBREATH'?
questions.f: It is the fourth Australian album to top the ARIA chart in 2026.

questions.q: Which music legend, 85, met Pope Leo XIV at the Vatican before a Rome concert?
questions.f: The Pope gave him a rosary, and he gave the Pope a copy of his memoir 'Chronicles'.

questions.q: For her 25th-anniversary Halloween party, Heidi Klum dressed as a giant version of which part of her own body?
questions.f: The severed-hand costume even had her real rings on it.

questions.q: Rockstar confirmed that pre-loading starts on 10 November for which game, ahead of its 19 November launch?
questions.f: The download is up to 212 GB on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S.

questions.q: In 'Primetime', No. 1 at the Australian box office, Robert Pattinson plays which real-life TV host?
questions.f: Hansen fronted 'To Catch a Predator' and has called the film a complete work of fiction.
